summary: Unified memory architecture and reasoning workflows by integrating high-performance vector storage with a grounded attribution layer. Implemented verification mechanisms to cross-reference architectural assertions, utilizing self-consistency sampling and semantic chunking to mitigate hallucinations while optimizing I/O and latency.
key_learnings: Binary quantization and sqlite-vec enable high-performance vector storage with minimal overhead.
Grounding requires a strict separation between retrieval and reasoning engines.
Semantic chunking and RAGAS-lite evaluation are critical for retrieval relevance and signal integrity.
Self-consistency and early-exit strategies improve reasoning reliability and computational efficiency.
Mandatory attribution creates an essential audit trail for system decisions when balanced against token velocity.
